name: trento-live-activity-backend
description: Backend for Trento Live Activity civic-tech platform

scripts.db:sync: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { sequelize } = require('./src/data/db'); sequelize.sync({ force: true }).then(() => { console.log('DB synced'); process.exit(0); })"
scripts.migrate:consents: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { Consent } = require('./src/data/models'); Consent.sync({ alter: true }).then(() => { console.log('Consents table ready'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
